section_title: From an agreement to a shared activity

paragraphs.text: A list of partner cities is a beginning. The next question is what people do together. Read an agreement, an event report and an exchange proposal differently: each answers a different question.

India’s San Francisco consulate records Purab Fest, organised by the Bhubaneswar–Cupertino group on 21 September 2024. Odissi performances accompanied stalls showing East Indian garments, crafts and food. This documents a cultural event, not measured benefits or a Project Odisha partnership.

For Project Odisha, the next step should be a shared question rather than a partnership announcement. Ask willing participants what they want to make, who will contribute and how the result will be used. Agree credit and responsibilities before organising an exchange, then invite participants to describe what worked and what needs to change.

notes.text: Consulate General of India, San Francisco, 23 September 2024.
